title: Teams Formation
statementMd:
This time the Berland Team Olympiad in Informatics is held in a remote city that can only be reached by one small bus. Bus has $*n*$ passenger seats, seat $*i*$ can be occupied only by a participant from the city $*a*_{*i*}$.

Today the bus has completed $*m*$ trips, each time bringing $*n*$ participants. The participants were then aligned in one line in the order they arrived, with people from the same bus standing in the order of their seats (i. e. if we write down the cities where the participants came from, we get the sequence $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ repeated $*m*$ times).

After that some teams were formed, each consisting of $*k*$ participants form the same city standing next to each other in the line. Once formed, teams left the line. The teams were formed until there were no $*k*$ neighboring participants from the same city.

Help the organizers determine how many participants have left in the line after that process ended. We can prove that answer doesn't depend on the order in which teams were selected.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*, *k*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$).

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$), where $*a*_{*i*}$ is the number of city, person from which must take seat $*i*$ in the bus.

## Output

Output the number of remaining participants in the line.

## Note

In the second example, the line consists of ten participants from the same city. Nine of them will form a team. At the end, only one participant will stay in the line.
statementZhMd:
这一次，Berland 信息学团体奥林匹克竞赛在一座偏远城市举行，这座城市只能乘坐一辆小型巴士到达。巴士有 $*n*$ 个乘客座位，第 $*i*$ 个座位只能由来自城市 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的参赛者乘坐。

今天，巴士已经完成了 $*m*$ 次行程，每次带来 $*n*$ 名参赛者。随后，参赛者按照到达顺序排成一列，同一辆巴士上的人按照座位顺序排列（也就是说，如果我们写下参赛者来自的城市，就会得到序列 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ 重复 $*m*$ 次）。

之后，一些队伍被组建出来，每个队伍由队伍中相邻且来自同一城市的 $*k*$ 名参赛者组成。队伍组建后，这些参赛者就会离开队列。队伍会一直组建，直到队列中不存在 $*k*$ 名相邻且来自同一城市的参赛者为止。

请帮助组织者确定上述过程结束后队列中还剩下多少名参赛者。可以证明，无论选择队伍的顺序如何，答案都不会改变。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$2 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{9}$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$）。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$），其中 $*a*_{*i*$ 表示必须乘坐巴士第 $*i*$ 个座位的参赛者所在的城市编号。

## 输出格式

输出过程结束后队列中剩余的参赛者数量。

## 说明

在第二个样例中，队列由十名来自同一城市的参赛者组成。其中九人会组成一个队伍，最终队列中只会剩下一名参赛者。
